newFindingPolicy: No pre-existing finding may be added after freeze. Only a regression directly caused by an authorized mutation may be repaired inside the same exact dependency closure.
boundedProductQuestion: Can STEP 07 prove local same-session observer lifecycle continuity and valid accessibility structure without changing gameplay, Hanzi content, save semantics, privacy, or child-facing value choices?
childValue: The child can keep playing safely when the optional adult observer disconnects, and assistive navigation has one predictable page structure.
hanziLearningValue: The accepted component-placement and meaning-magic learning loop remains frozen and unchanged while its route and evidence harness become reliable.
explicitNonGoals: new Hanzi or remaining eight characters
remote telemetry or additional child data

findings.rootCause: Ordinary non-first-use Golden Slice rendering exposes the internal build identifier through the existing golden-seed element; pre-change evidence proves this predates STEP 07.
findings.exactMutation: None in this closure. Removing the identifier would be a visible child-surface polish change and does not meet the authorized zero-visual-change SEV-4 condition.

findings.rootCause: mountClassicHubFromWorld creates an outer main wrapper and then mountHub creates the authoritative catalog main inside it.
findings.exactMutation: Change only the outer classic-hub-from-world wrapper from main to div; preserve mountHub main, navigation, layout, and behavior. Add fail-closed one-main/non-nested-main evidence assertions and validator fields.
affectedEvidence: classic hub visual and ARIA candidate

findings.rootCause: The persistent visible Golden Slice route title is a plain span, so the document has no H1 while overlay headings begin at H2.
findings.exactMutation: Expose the existing title as the single H1 and explicitly reset margin, font, font-size, font-weight, line-height, letter-spacing, and color to inherited values; preserve H2 dialog and H3 content headings and exact visual appearance.
affectedEvidence: Golden Slice camp, ability, spellbook, desktop, mobile, and reduced-motion visual/ARIA rows

findings.rootCause: The full technical export filename is used as visible button text at 320 pixels, causing mid-token line wrapping while preserving function and accessible name.
findings.exactMutation: None in this closure. Shortening the visible label would intentionally alter the rendered adult-tool UI and is not required to close a blocker.

findings.rootCause: The existing static/deep harness never executes active disconnect/recovery, fallback, reload, history, or conflict cases; additionally the observer stores its active grant only in page locals, pagehide removes fixture continuity, and pending-stop replay can invoke callbacks before bridge assignment.
findings.exactMutation: Persist and validate an observer-only active-session pointer; resume the same live grant without re-emitting session_opened; defer fixture cleanup until explicit teardown; make pending-stop delivery occur after bridge construction; add L1-L6 same-context browser scenarios, source-bound lifecycle evidence, formal validator integration, and mutation-based negative controls. Keep all data local and allowlisted.

findings.rootCause: Existing profiles exercise paced clicks, keyboard actions, and reversible invalid placements but never burst or duplicate actuation at transition boundaries.
findings.exactMutation: Add deterministic burst-input browser coverage for selection, placement, ability, boss completion, finish-run, and return-world boundaries; assert one logical transition/save update and no console or page errors. Stop if an out-of-charter product defect is exposed.

findings.rootCause: Same atomic nested-main defect as R2_CLASSIC_NESTED_MAIN_LANDMARK, independently identified by R3.
findings.exactMutation: Close with the same outer-wrapper div mutation and one-main/non-nested-main fail-closed assertions used for the R2 finding; retain this reviewer finding separately in lineage.
affectedEvidence: classic hub visual and ARIA candidate
